SOCIAL STUDIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #13
====

GRADE: Grade 7
SUBJECT: SOCIAL STUDIES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which statement about Human Origin is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Human Origin as rumours only.
   B. Say Human Origin never happens in Kenya.
   C. Explain Human Origin with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Human Origin.

2. Which statement about Self- Exploration is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Self- Exploration never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat Self- Exploration as rumours only.
   C. Explain Self- Exploration with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Self- Exploration.

3. Which statement about Maps and Map Work 10 4.4 Earth and the Solar System 5 4.5 Weather 5 Page 13 of 6 is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Maps and Map Work 10 4.4 Earth and the Solar System 5 4.5 Weather 5 Page 13 of 6 with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Maps and Map Work 10 4.4 Earth and the Solar System 5 4.5 Weather 5 Page 13 of 6.
   C. Say Maps and Map Work 10 4.4 Earth and the Solar System 5 4.5 Weather 5 Page 13 of 6 never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat Maps and Map Work 10 4.4 Earth and the Solar System 5 4.5 Weather 5 Page 13 of 6 as rumours only.

4. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Explain symbols used on a map
   B. Replace the compass rose
   C. Name the president
   D. Measure rainfall only

5. Which statement about Historical information is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Historical information.
   B. Explain Historical information with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Historical information as rumours only.
   D. Say Historical information never happens in Kenya.

6. Which statement about Maps and map work is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Maps and map work.
   B. Explain Maps and map work with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Say Maps and map work never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat Maps and map work as rumours only.

7. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Destroying road signs
   B. Littering in markets
   C. Avoiding all community work
   D. Obeying laws and caring for public property

8. Which statement about Early Civilisation is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Early Civilisation.
   B. Say Early Civilisation never happens in Kenya.
   C. Explain Early Civilisation with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Treat Early Civilisation as rumours only.

9. Which statement about Slavery and Servitude is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Slavery and Servitude as rumours only.
   B. Explain Slavery and Servitude with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Slavery and Servitude.
   D. Say Slavery and Servitude never happens in Kenya.

10. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Kisumu
   B. Nairobi
   C. Mombasa
   D. Nakuru

11. Which statement about Entrepreneurial Opportunities in Social Studies is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Entrepreneurial Opportunities in Social Studies.
   B. Say Entrepreneurial Opportunities in Social Studies never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Entrepreneurial Opportunities in Social Studies as rumours only.
   D. Explain Entrepreneurial Opportunities in Social Studies with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

12. Which statement about Historical Development of Agriculture is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Historical Development of Agriculture never happens in Kenya.
   B. Explain Historical Development of Agriculture with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Historical Development of Agriculture.
   D. Treat Historical Development of Agriculture as rumours only.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Early Civilisation and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Slavery and Servitude and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Developments in Medium of trade and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Diversity and interpersonal relationships and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
